prompt.goal: Chu phong co the loai thanh vien ra khoi acc/phong dung quyen va co xac nhan.
prompt.context: Doc FRS section 6.5 (Kick thanh vien) va section 8.7. Doc Task 7 trong docs/workflow/03_Task_Breakdown.md. Task 6 da co nen CRUD + skeleton kick; Task 7 chuan hoa day du luong kick theo AC. Chi sua modules/memberships/, modules/accs/ (doc members neu can), features/acc-management/. Khong sua invitation, play-session, CRUD update/delete acc (tru khi can de hien thi KICKED).

scope.allowed: - Kick thanh vien ra khoi acc - Hien thi/an nut kick theo quyen chu phong - Modal xac nhan truoc khi kick - Cap nhat trang thai member sang KICKED - Ghi lich su kick (thoi diem + nguoi thuc hien) - Canh bao ro neu member dang choi hoac cho xac nhan logout - Member bi kick mat quyen thao tac ngay - Hien thi trang thai da kick tren danh sach member (neu con trong detail)
scope.notAllowed: - Khong lam CRUD acc (Task 6) - Khong lam moi thanh vien (Task 4) - Khong lam trang thai choi (Task 5) - Khong add thang member

hardRules.rule: Chi owner moi thay va dung duoc nut kick.
Moi lan kick bat buoc dialog xac nhan truoc khi goi API.
Member bi kick mat quyen truy cap acc ngay (leftAt + KICKED).
Neu dang PLAYING/PENDING_LOGOUT van kick duoc, UI canh bao, acc tra ve AVAILABLE.

tasks.task: Dam bao API DELETE /api/v1/accs/:id/members/:memberId dung owner check va KICKED.
Ghi status_history MEMBER_KICK voi timestamp va actor (nguoi kick) trong note/user.
UI nut Kick chi owner; modal xac nhan; canh bao khi dang giu acc.
Cap nhat UI trang thai sau kick; member bi kick khong thao tac duoc.

constraints.constraint: Hanh dong kick phai co dialog xac nhan.
Lich su kick phai co thoi diem va nguoi thuc hien.
Khong mo rong sang invitation hay play flow.

acceptanceCriteria.criteria: Chi chu phong thay va dung nut kick.
Thanh vien bi kick khong con quyen thao tac trong acc do.
Kick phai xac nhan ro rang truoc khi thuc thi.
Kick member dang choi / cho logout van duoc, co canh bao ro.
Lich su kick ghi dung thoi diem va nguoi thuc hien.

testPlan.item: So sanh nut kick owner vs member thuong.
Member bi kick khong mo detail / khong play.
Kick member dang PLAYING: acc AVAILABLE, history ok.
History hien thi actor va thoi gian.

outputRequired.item: Luong kick member hoan chinh (API + UI)
Modal xac nhan + canh bao holder
